AVAILABLE FOR SHIPPING, OR PICKUP IN: Wisconsin year-round, Arizona Jan/Feb

Our SAWMASTER 18’’ Large Cutting machine from Rhino Lapidary

is designed for cutting all kinds of materials such as gemstones, marble, ceramics, glass and granite in a fast, safe and standard way in the desired thickness. Thanks to the high technology and durable materials used in our machine, you can cut without any problems for years.

A key feature in this machine are patented longitudinal, anti-vibration, sealed bearings which provide a wiggle-free vice. This makes your cut less prone to breaking and extensive saw-marks, even at a thickness of 1.5mm.

Cutting speed is 8mm/min (1 inch in 3 minutes). In addition, with the Auto-Feed system, patented by Rhino Lapidary, when the saw gets tired or cannot cut for any reason, the vice advancement system automatically slows down and reduces the load of the saw. This extends the life of your saw. It prevents damages such as jamming and breaking caused by user errors. It also protects the motor by slowing down the cutting when necessary and prevents it from heating and burning.

In addition, the machine has an automatic stop feature in place for when the cutting is finished or if the cover is opened while it is working. All parts are CE and TSEK certified.

Fits up to 18" Saw

Blade not included

Electricity: 110V 60HZ

Cutting Height: 6 1/2"

Cutting Length: 9 7/8"

Cutting Speed: 7/8’’/min

Motor: 1.8KW 1700rpm with crossfeed

Machine Dimensions: 105cm width x 130cm length x 130cm height

Machine Weight: 287lbs

Blade not included

All parts are CE and TSEK certified

?Sawing slabs and stones for years in comfort is possible with the new TRIMMASTER trim saw!

You will never have a rusted cutting platform of your machine again, thanks to the Plexiglass surface that easily lifts away. The plexiglass has 4 drainage holes to keep water/oil in the lower reservoir, and adjustable feet let you ensure the tilt is correct for the drainage, even if you are not on a perfectly level surface.

The Trimmaster also comes with spacers for the plexiglass cover that allow you to raise it over the edge of the cutting platform for cutting larger material. There is also a removable, straight-edge guide included for consistent and accurate cutting.

?Sawing slabs and stones for years in comfort is possible with the new TRIMMASTER trim saw!

You will never have a rusted cutting platform of your machine again, thanks to the Plexiglass surface that easily lifts away. The plexiglass has 4 drainage holes to keep water/oil in the lower reservoir, and adjustable feet let you ensure the tilt is correct for the drainage, even if you are not on a perfectly level surface.

The Trimmaster also comes with spacers for the plexiglass cover that allow you to raise it over the edge of the cutting platform for cutting larger material. There is also a removable, straight-edge guide included for consistent and accurate cutting.

Shipping policy
Shipping policy

Shipping: We primarily ship via U.S. Posta Service, UPS, or Freight. Typical delivery time ranges 3-10 days. Freight may take longer up to 4 weeks. It is possible for us to use other carriers, please reach out with any questions.

Calculating Shipping Costs: When you place an order, the shipping estimate is based on the weight of your item and the shipping method you chose. The weight of our items can be found on its detail page. For international orders – we can ship virtually anywhere in the world. Please call or contact us to find out if the item(s) you are interested in can be shipped internationally. Brokerage and customs fees are the responsibility of the customer. We do not have any information on these charges; they are incurred at your country’s Port of Entry.

Damage in Shipment: Please save all packing material, receipts, and photos of damage, until your case is resolved. In most cases any damage done in transit must be made to the carrier.

Home
/
Refund policy
Refund policy

Returns: If you are not satisfied with any product, you may return it for a full refund of the purchase price, provided the return takes place within 30 days of delivery. All returns must be complete and show no signs of wear or damage. Any item returned after the 30 days may be return may not be accepted for refund and will incur a 50% re-stocking fee. Customers are responsible for any return postage, unless the return is a result of our error, in which case, we will provide you with a pre-paid return label.

Defective Product: In the rare cases a product may contain a manufacturing defect, please reach out immediately to our customer service team. You can call us at (262) 377-4666 or email us at mail@thegemshop.com, and we will respond quickly to your message.


Non-returnable Items: There are certain items that cannot be returned for specific reasons. They include: special orders, items that have been modified, used equipment, discontinued products, items not normally stocked, etc.
